user.title: Whodunit
user.description: Whodunit follows Home Assistant's context links to explain why each light, switch or helper changed, and warns you when automations fight over the same entity.

data.notify: Show a notification when a fight starts

data_description.fight_flips: A fight starts when an entity changes this many times inside the window and at least two different actors caused those changes.
data_description.fight_window: How far back to look for flips, and how long a fight must be quiet to end.
data_description.tracked_domains: Entities in other domains still appear as triggers in chains, they just don't get their own history.

explain.name: Explain
explain.description: Explain why entities are in their current state, as data and as a sentence you can speak or send.

limit.name: Changes
limit.description: How many recent changes to explain per entity.
